projects.title: Manage 33 Units on TurboTenant
projects.full_description:
I'm an experienced Arizona real estate investor looking for a long-term partner, not a one-off gig. I need a detail-oriented virtual property manager to run day-to-day operations across my 33-unit portfolio, working under my direction. You'll own the tenant lifecycle from first inquiry to move-out, supported by documented SOPs, scripts, and notice templates.

THE PORTFOLIO
- 20 spaces at an RV park (long-term, with an onsite host)
- 10 spaces at a mobile home park (long-term, with an onsite host)
- 3 furnished mid-term units in central Phoenix

Onsite hosts greet residents, show units, and report issues. They don't handle money. You'll coordinate with them remotely.

HOURS & PAY
Part-time, approximately 8–15 hours/week. Workload varies with vacancies and turnovers, with a heavier first month during onboarding. $7–$9/hour depending on experience.

TIME ZONE
Arizona runs on MST year-round (UTC-7; no daylight saving time). I prefer candidates with significant overlap with Arizona business hours (8 AM–6 PM MST). Candidates further away are welcome to apply, but a structured 30-day paid trial with set overlap hours and daily check-ins is required before any long-term commitment.

WHAT YOU'LL HANDLE

Marketing & Leads
- Check and respond to inquiries every day across TurboTenant, Furnished Finder, Zillow, and Facebook (Marketplace and groups), within 2 hours during business hours
- Keep every listing current and keep improving it: pricing, availability, photos, descriptions
- Send a weekly marketing report: where each vacancy is listed, inquiries, showings, and applications

Screening & Leasing
- Screen applicants through TurboTenant: credit, criminal background, eviction history, and income/employment verification
- Apply my written rental criteria consistently and deliver a concise screening summary with your recommendation. I make the final decision.
- Prepare leases and collect deposits
- Make sure every resident has a current signed lease on file

Mid-Term Turnovers
- Manage booking calendars to minimize vacancy between stays
- Schedule and confirm cleaners between every stay
- Handle check-in and check-out: access instructions, welcome info, and post-stay inspections
- Track furnishings, linens, and supplies, and restock as needed

Rent & Monthly Reporting
- Check rent received against the bank from the 1st to the 5th, marking each unit paid, partial, or late
- Send late notices after each lease's grace period, using the templates on file
- Prepare a monthly rent roll and income/cost summary for each property by the 5th
- Handle monthly meter readings and utility billing at both parks

Maintenance
- Receive and triage maintenance requests, dispatch approved vendors, and track work to completion
- Record every repair cost against the correct property
- Escalate emergencies immediately and get my approval on repairs above an agreed dollar amount

Records & Property Reviews
- Keep resident and property files organized using our Drive filing system, with a complete file at every move-in and move-out (lease, ID, checklist, deposit record)
- Complete a quarterly review of each property with the onsite hosts and update its fact sheet

WHAT YOU'LL ESCALATE TO ME
Vacancies longer than 30 days, residents more than one month behind, repairs above the approval limit, and any decision on rent levels or evictions.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED
- Occupancy and days vacant
- Rent collected vs. rent due
- Response time to new leads
- Repairs and turnovers completed on time
- Monthly reports delivered on schedule

WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR
- REQUIRED: Hands-on TurboTenant experience. Describe how you've used it (listings, screening, leases, rent, maintenance) in the first lines of your proposal. Proposals without TurboTenant experience won't be considered.
- Proven experience as a virtual property manager, leasing coordinator, or property management assistant
- Comfort with basic bookkeeping tasks: rent rolls, matching payments to bank records, tracking costs by property
- Excellent written and spoken English
- Working knowledge of Fair Housing rules and consistent, criteria-based screening
- Discretion with tenant data and screening reports
- Organized and process-driven, with the habit of following SOPs and documenting your work

Nice to have: Furnished Finder, Zillow Rental Manager, or Facebook Marketplace experience, and experience with furnished mid-term rentals or mobile home/RV parks.

WHAT YOU GET
- A stable, owner-operated portfolio with consistent work
- Documented SOPs, scripts, and notice templates from day one
- Platform logins and an organized Drive filing system
- A long-term role with room to grow into additional properties

HOW WE'LL START
Finalists will complete a short paid test task. The hire then begins with a trial period covering current inquiries, open applications, and upcoming turnovers, and moves into an ongoing role if we're a good fit.

TO APPLY
Start your proposal with the word "Saguaro" and answer:
1. How long have you used TurboTenant, and which features have you managed? What other rental platforms have you worked with?
2. Have you managed furnished mid-term rentals or RV/mobile home parks? Briefly describe your role.
3. How would you handle an applicant whose credit meets criteria but whose income verification is incomplete?
4. What time zone are you in, and when would you check inquiries each day?

# Hiring: Senior Full-Stack Developer for PRESTIA AI

**Project Type:** 
Full-Stack SaaS Platform MVP

**Delivery Deadline:** 30 Calendar Days
**Warranty:** 180 Days
**Budget:** Open to Competitive Proposals — Based on the Full Scope of Work

## Project Overview

We are seeking an experienced Full-Stack Developer to build **PRESTIA AI Revenue Growth Platform**, a high-conversion commercial platform designed to sell AI-powered automation and revenue growth solutions to the US market.

This is not a simple corporate website. The goal is to build a functional sales platform that converts visitors into customers, increases average order value through relevant upsells, and supports recurring revenue.

## Core Requirements

**1. Website & Sales Funnels**
- Build 10 reusable page templates supporting approximately 18–22 functional pages or sales funnels.
- Implement five core packages: ACQUIRE, CONVERT, AUTOMATE, RETAIN, and REVENUE OS.
- Include pricing, industry solutions, interactive assessment, revenue calculator, checkout, confirmation, and legal pages.
- Support English and Arabic, including full RTL layout and responsive design.

**2. Upsell & Sales Engine**
- Implement a library of 30 upsell services.
- Configure relevant offers on sales pages and checkout pages.
- Build a dynamic Upsell/Downsell engine supporting sequences of 10–15 offers with conditional acceptance and rejection logic.
- Support one-click upsells where permitted by the payment provider.
- Ensure accurate pricing, discounts, order totals, and explicit customer consent.

**3. Payment & Integrations**
- Integrate Stripe and PayPal.
- Assist with API configuration and payment account setup.
- Implement secure server-side payment verification, Webhooks, and duplicate transaction prevention.
- Integrate Supabase and GoHighLevel (GHL) as specified.
- Follow security best practices and never store raw card numbers or CVV/CVC data on the platform's servers.

**4. Technology Stack**
- Frontend: [login to view URL] 14+ App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- Backend & Database: Supabase, PostgreSQL, Row Level Security.
- Payments: Stripe and PayPal.
- Deployment: GitHub, Vercel, and Supabase under the Owner’s accounts.

WordPress, Elementor, Bootstrap, and ready-made website templates are prohibited.

## Delivery & Acceptance Requirements

- Deliver the complete, functional platform within 30 calendar days.
- Provide three weekly Loom videos demonstrating actual progress and working functionality.
- Complete end-to-end testing of the pages, payment flows, upsells, database, and integrations.
- Deliver the complete source code, documentation, project files, and administrative access.
- Deploy the platform to the Owner’s accounts.
- Provide a 180-day warranty covering bugs, security defects, and non-conformities within the agreed scope, at no additional cost.
- Begin addressing critical defects within 24 hours, targeting resolution within 24–48 hours where technically feasible.

Final acceptance is subject to the agreed functional tests and delivery requirements, not merely submission of code or visual designs.

## Contract & Payment Terms

- Fixed-price contract based on the complete approved scope.
- The Developer must clearly identify any exclusions, third-party costs, or technical limitations before the contract is awarded.
- Payment, acceptance, and refund arrangements must comply with the agreed freelancing platform’s rules.
- All project-specific deliverables and source code shall be transferred to the Owner according to the agreed intellectual property terms.

## How to Apply

Please provide:

1. Links to three relevant projects demonstrating experience with [login to view URL] and payment integrations.
2. Your proposed total fixed price for the complete scope.
3. Your confirmation that you can meet the 30-day deadline.
4. Confirmation that you accept the testing, delivery, ownership, and 180-day warranty requirements.
5. Any assumptions, exclusions, or third-party costs associated with your proposal.

**Selection Criteria:** Proven experience, technical competence, realistic pricing, delivery reliability, and full acceptance of the project requirements.

Please submit your best competitive offer for the complete project.

पैरासिटामोल (Paracetamol / Acetaminophen) एक बहुत ही सामान्य दवा है, जिसका उपयोग मुख्य रूप से बुखार (Fever) और हल्के से मध्यम दर्द (Pain Relief) के लिए किया जाता है।
इसे बेहतर तरीके से समझने के लिए इसकी खुराक (Dosage), प्रकार (Types), और संयोजन (Combinations) के बारे में जानकारी नीचे दी गई है:
1. पैरासिटामोल की अलग-अलग डोज (Dosages)
| डोज (Mg) | उपयोग / स्थिति | विवरण |
|---|---|---|
| 500 mg | हल्का बुखार या सिरदर्द | सामान्य दर्द और हल्के बुखार के लिए ली जाती है। |
| 650 mg | तेज बुखार या तेज बदन दर्द | वयस्कों में अधिक बुखार (जैसे Crocin 650, Dolo 650) के लिए उपयोग होती है। |
| Syrup / Drops | बच्चों के लिए (120 mg/5ml, 250 mg/5ml) | उम्र और वजन के हिसाब से दी जाती है। |
2. कॉम्बिनेशन दवाएं (Different Combinations)
बाजार में पैरासिटामोल केवल प्लेन (Plain) ही नहीं, बल्कि दूसरी साल्ट्स (APIs) के साथ मिलाकर भी मिलती है:
 * Paracetamol + Aceclofenac / Diclofenac: दर्द और सूजन (Inflammation) को कम करने के लिए दी जाती है।
 * Paracetamol + Phenylephrine + Chlorpheniramine: सर्दी, जुकाम और बहती नाक (Cold & Flu) के इलाज के लिए।
 * Paracetamol + Caffeine: माइग्रेन या तेज सिरदर्द के लिए।
3. मुख्य सावधानी और दिशा-निर्देश (Important Rules)
 * 24 घंटे की अधिकतम सीमा: एक वयस्क को एक दिन (24 घंटे) में 4000 mg (4 ग्राम) से अधिक पैरासिटामोल नहीं लेनी चाहिए।
 * दो डोज के बीच का अंतर: कम से कम 4 से 6 घंटे का अंतर होना जरूरी है।
 * लिवर पर असर: इसका जरूरत से ज्यादा सेवन या शराब (Alcohol) के साथ लेना लिवर के लिए नुकसानदायक हो सकता है।
> नोट: किसी भी दवा का सेवन डॉक्टर या फार्मासिस्ट की सलाह के बिना न करें।

projects.title: Enter Text from Word Docs
projects.full_description:
I have a collection of typed Word documents that need to be re-entered as plain text inside the template I will provide. It is a straight text-input job—no spreadsheet formulas, no database work—just accurate, line-for-line transcription of what you see on the screen.

Here is how the task will run:
• I will share the Word files plus a simple text template (TXT or DOCX, your choice). 
• You copy the content exactly, preserving paragraph breaks and basic headings, and return each file under the same name. 
• Before sending anything back, check for obvious typos and ensure no formatting tags slip in.

Turnaround is flexible but steady progress is important; let me know your realistic daily capacity so I can queue the files accordingly. Accuracy matters more than speed, so I will review the first batch for consistency before releasing the remaining documents.

Deliverable: a folder of clean text files that mirror the original Word docs, ready for my editorial pass.

If you’re comfortable with straightforward text entry and can keep an eye on detail, this will be quick, repeatable work.

projects.title: Beginner Futures Trading Course
projects.full_description:
I want to publish a complete futures-trading curriculum that takes absolute beginners from “What is a futures contract?” all the way to confidently placing their first live trade. The sole teaching medium will be video lectures, so every concept needs to come alive on screen through clear narration, chart-based demonstrations, and concise slide summaries.

Core content that must be woven into the series: 
• Technical Analysis – chart patterns, indicators, market structure, order flow 
• Risk Management – position sizing, margin, draw-down limits, psychological risk control 
• Trading Strategies – trend-following, range trading, breakout tactics, plus a walkthrough of two sample trade plans the student can replicate

Structure & expectations 
• Roughly 3–5 hours of HD video, split into logically progressive modules (intro, foundations, strategy deep dives, practical walkthroughs, recap) 
• Each lecture should include on-screen examples using real historical data from platforms such as TradingView or Thinkorswim to keep things relatable. 
• Script or detailed outline for every video so I can review accuracy before recording. 
• Plain-English explanations; no prior trading knowledge assumed. 

Acceptance criteria 
1. All listed topics are covered in beginner-friendly language. 
2. Videos are screen-recorded at 1080p with clear audio and branded title cards. 
3. Final delivery includes editable project files (e.g., PowerPoint decks or screen-capture source files) alongside rendered MP4s. 

If you have experience teaching new traders and can communicate complex ideas simply, I’d love to see a short sample or portfolio link when we start the conversation.

A simple, well-organized .xlsx file that mirrors the PDF layout is the expected deliverable.

projects.title: Buy Licensed GitHub Codebases
projects.full_description:
I’m inviting owners of mature, private GitHub projects to license or transfer their codebases for use in research and AI/ML model training. To qualify, your project should already be finished, maintained over time, and meet these baseline metrics:

• Hosted privately on GitHub 
• At least one repository with 5 000+ lines of code (multi-repo projects are welcome) 
• 100+ commits or merged PRs spanning a minimum of 5–6 months of history 
• Comprehensive README or other documentation in the repo 

Before sharing, please strip any API keys or paid-service credentials; we will not ask for or use them. When you respond, include a brief overview of the project’s purpose, tech stack, and how you’d like to structure the license or transfer. I will then arrange secure, time-boxed access to verify the repository contents and history.

Deliverable
• Verified access to the private GitHub repository (or repositories) so I can review code, commit history, and documentation prior to completing the licensing agreement.

projects.full_description:
I’m putting together a concise book-review style article that focuses on an education-related title of your choice, and I need a skilled article writer to craft it for me. The review should flow naturally, offer clear insights into the book’s key themes, strengths, and weaknesses, and close with an informed recommendation for readers in the education field.

Please deliver a well-structured, original piece written in Indonesian, formatted as a standard online article. Citations, if used, must be accurate. I’m open to your creative approach as long as the final draft reads like a thoughtful, engaging education book review that could easily fit in a student blog or academic newsletter.
